criteria.AC-01: Three fresh actual candidate pipelines preserve the complete fixed 43/46-row grid and matching original JSON/TXT/JUnit bytes; healthy full native SVD projections retain all packages and provenance.
criteria.AC-02: The actual wrong expected version remains failed/ineligible with blocked SVD; strict source fixtures reject missing/duplicate/malformed/wrong-identity/applicability evidence and separate cleanup from primary failure.
criteria.AC-03: Fixed safe exports/checksums bind tested candidate files and report/native SVD bytes. Private state, keys, raw captures and host paths remain outside portable projections.

limitations: Reference scope is one Ubuntu or UBI candidate-bound container per Run with generated source and a synthetic assessment.
Original captures/private runtime inputs remain private and are replayed by the reviewed domain; this delivery rechecks original receipt bindings and exact pure report/projection hashes.
A negative harness pass preserves its failed underlying pipeline. Controlled wrong expectation does not damage the payload.
Finished original admission archive hashes and exact owned-resource dispositions are retained; host measurement details are omitted.
Helper/provisioner tools are execution provenance, and the target kernel is shared. UBI retains its limited authentication AUDIT_WRITE side effect.
Storage figures are samples, not hard quotas; scoped scans are not comprehensive. Optional PowerShell is excluded.
No twenty-target candidate qualification, VM/ISO boot, scanner/STIG acceptance, publication or Owner acceptance follows.
